content: Ahá Ánɩ́ Bulu Lalɛ́
Mɩ́a Kristonyɔ anɩlabwɛ́ kʋlɛ. Mʋ́ sʋ ɔnɔkwalɩ asʋ́n ndɛblɩ́ séi. Ɔŋɛ Wankɩ́hɛ́ dɛ́ mɩ́ kpa. Mʋ́ sʋ mɩ́ klʋn ɛ́ dɛ mɩ́ bláa ánɩ́ mmɛdɛ́ afunu wa.
Mɩ́ pɩ Israelfɔ sʋ asʋ́n ɩhɩ́ɛ́ dɛ mɩ́ háan, ahʋmɩtɩá ɩmɛká itin dɛ mɩ́.
Nɩ́ ɩbɔ́wa alɛ́á nénya ɩlwɩɩ́, mɩ́a Kristonyɔ nsɩnɛ́ béyintá, mɛ́nɩ bénya nkpa ánɩ́ ɩtamatá kʋ́ráá á, tɛkɩ nɔ́pʋ ɩwɩ há.

Mɩ́ pɩ Israelfɔ gyí ahá ánɩ́ Bulu lɛ́lɛ pʋ́bwɛ́ mʋ abí. Amʋ́ ɔlɛlɛ mʋ numnyam súná. Ɔlɛka ntam há amʋ́, pʋ́ mʋ mbla wá amʋ́ ɩbɩtɔ. Olosuná amʋ́ ɔkpa ánɩ́ bɔ́pʋtswɛ mʋ. Ɔlɛbláa amʋ́ tɔ́á alahɩ́ɛ́ ánɩ́ ɔbɔ́pʋhá amʋ́ fɛ́ɛ́.

Amʋ́ lɛ́lɩn tsu Israelfɔ anáin akpɔnkpɔntɩ ámʋtɔ. Mʋ́á ɩdʋn kʋ́ráá á, amʋ́tɔ́ Kristo amʋ lɛ́bɛlɩn ɔsʋlʋ́ʋ anfɩsʋ. Kanfʋ́ letsiá Kristo, (ɔhá ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu ladá mʋ ofúli amʋ), ogyi Bulu, atɔ́ fɛ́ɛ́sʋ́ ogyípʋ́ amʋ brɛ́ fɛ́ɛ́tɔ́! Amen!
Ɩ́nɩ imosuná ánɩ́ Bulu asʋ́n ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛblɩ́ tswɩ amʋ ɩmɛ́ɛba mʋ́tɔ́. Tsúfɛ́ megyí Israelfɔ ámʋ fɛ́ɛ́ gyí Israelfɔ onutónutó.
Megyí Abraham abí fɛ́ɛ́ gyí mʋ abí onutó. Tsúfɛ́ Bulu lɛ́bláa Abraham ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Isaktɔ fʋ́ abí-aná bɛ́dalɩ tsu.”
Ɩ́nɩ lósuná ánɩ́ megyí ahá ánɩ́ botsú Abraham abí fɛ́ɛ́tɔ́ gyí Bulu ahá. Abraham abí-aná ámʋ́ʋ́ Bulu lɛ́hɩɛ há mʋ amʋ nkʋlɛ gyí Bulu ahá.
Tsúfɛ́ tɔ́á Bulu lɛ́hɩɛ Abraham gyí, “Néyinkí bá ofíébá sɛsɛbrɛ. Nɛ́ba a, fʋ́ ká Sara lakwɩ́ɩ́ obiyímbi.”
Megyí ɩ́nɩ wʋlɛ. Rebeka lɔ́kwɩɩ́ atabí há anɩ náin Isak.

Támɛ brɛ́á ɔmɔkʋ́nyá kwɩ́ɩ́ amʋ́, abʋdan bɩ yilé ntɛ́ɛ lalahɛbwɛ á, Bulu lɛ́bláa Rebeka amʋ́ ɩwɩ asʋ́n. Bulu lɔ́bwɛ mʋ́ alɩ, mɛ́nɩ ibósuná anɩ ánɩ́ ɔkpa ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔtɔtsʋn mʋ́sʋ́ hɔ ahá ámʋ ɩmɛná anɩ bwɛhɛ́sʋ́. Mboún ɩna mʋ nkʋlɛ pɛ́ apɛ́ pʋ́ alɩá ɔtɛlɛ́ mʋ ahásʋ.
Asa Rebeka ɔbɔ́kwɩɩ́ nyebí ámʋ a, Bulu lɛ́bláa mʋ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ɔdɛ́hɛn obósum ɔkʋsʋ.”
Fɛ́ alɩá bɔwanlɩ́n wá Bulu asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ amʋtɔ bɛɛ, “Ntɔdwɛ́ Yakob dʋn Esau.”
Séi á, nkálɩ abɛ́blɩ́? Abɛ́blɩ́ anɩaa, Bulu asʋ́n mɛda ɔkpa lóó? Ɛkɛkɛɛkɛ!
Tsúfɛ́ Bulu lɛ́bláa Mose ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ahá ánɩ́ nówun amʋ́ nwɛ á, amʋ́ nówun nwɛ. Amʋ́á nahɩ́ɛ́á négyi bʋalɛ a, amʋ́ négyi bʋalɛ.”
Mʋ́ sʋ megyí ɔha apɛ́ ntɛ́ɛ mʋ nsiwa Bulu tɛkɩ. Mboún mʋ onutó nwewúun igyi.

Bɔwanlɩ́n wá Bulu asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ amʋtɔ bɛɛ, Bulu lɛ́bláa Egyipte owíe Farao ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Atoku anyɔ ánfɩ sʋ nɛyaɩ́ fʋ́ iwíe, alɩá nɔ́tsʋn fʋsʋ lɛ́ mɩ́ túmi súná, pʋ́ alɩá ɔyɩ́tɔ́ ahá fɛ́ɛ́ bónu mɩ́ dá, kanfʋ́ mɩ́.”
Ɩ́nɩ sʋ nɩ́ Bulu ɔhɩ́ɛ́ ánɩ́ obówun ɔkʋ nwɛ á, otowun mʋ nwɛ. Nɩ́ ɔhɩ́ɛ́ ánɩ́ ɔbɛ́ha ɔkʋ ɔbɔ́wa klʋntɔ odwin ɛ́ á, ɔtɛhá mʋ ɔtɔwá klʋntɔ odwin.
Bulu Ɔblɔ́nya Pʋ́ Mʋ Ahá Nwewúun
Mlɩtɔ ɔkʋ ɔbɛ́fɩtɛ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ alɩ igyi nɩ́ mʋ́ á, ntogyi sʋ́ Bulu dɛ́ nyankpʋsa ɩpɔ́n ha? Ma ɔbɛ́talɩ́ tin Bulu ɔkpa?”
Támɛ ndɛ mlɩ fɩtɛ́ mbɛ́ɛ, fʋ́gyi ma ánɩ́ fɛ́lɛ Bulu ɩlá? Ɔlɔ́ ɔbɛ́talɩ́ fɩtɛ́ mʋ ɔpwɛpʋ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Ntogyi sʋ fapwɛ́ mɩ́ alɩ?”
Alɩágyíalɩ́á igyi á, atɔ́ ɔpwɛpʋ́ tɔ́pʋ́ obón pwɛ́ tɔ́á odeklé. Ɔbɛ́talɩ́ pʋ́ obón ipin kʋlɛ pwɛ́ nlonyɔ. Ɔbɔ́pʋ kʋlɛ bwɛ́ ɔlɔ́ nu ntsu, kpá nsúó wá kʋlɛtɔ.
Alɩ kɛ́n igyi há Bulu nɩ́. Ɔbʋ ɔkpa lɛ́ mʋ ɔblɔ́ súná, mɛ́nɩ ahá bówun mʋ túmi. Támɛ ɔlɛhɩɛ nyá klʋn há ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ olenya ɔblɔ́ amʋ́sʋ́ amʋ. Tɛkɩ ɩlɔfʋn ánɩ́ ɔbɛ́hɩ amʋ́.
Bulu bʋ ɔkpa lɛ́ mʋ numnyam kpɔnkpɔntɩ ámʋ ɔwan ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛlɛ yáɩ́ ánɩ́ obówun amʋ́ nwɛ, ɔwa amʋ́ numnyam amʋsʋ.
Anɩgyí ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ ɔlɛlɛ yáɩ́ ámʋ nɩ. Megyí Yudafɔ nkʋlɛtɔ ɔlɛlɛ ahá. Ɔlɛlɛ ahá ánɩ́ bʋmegyí Yudafɔ akʋ ɛ́.
Bulu lɛ́blɩ́ mʋ ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ Hosea ɔwʋlʋ́tɔ́ ɔbɛ́ɛ,

content.text: “Nɛ́tɩ ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ tɛkɩ bʋmegyí mɩ́ ahá ámʋ mɩ́ ahá.
Ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ tɛkɩ ntamakle amʋ́ asʋ́n ámʋ ɔbɔ́bwɛ mɩ́ adwɛpʋ́.
Ɔtɩ́nɛ́ ámʋ́ʋ́ tɛkɩ nɛbláa amʋ́ mbɛ́ɛ, ‘Megyí mɩ́ ahá mlɩgyí’ ámʋ a,
ɩnʋfɔ nɛ́tɩ mbɛ́ɛ, ‘Bulu Ɔkɩankpapʋ abí’ nɩ́.”

content: Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ Yesaia lɔ́kplʋn bláa Israelfɔ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ Israelfɔ bɛklɛ́ɩ́ fɛ́ ɔpʋ ɔnɔ́ ɩsɩ kʋ́ráá á, amʋ́tɔ́ ahá kpalobí pɛ́ nɔ́hɔ nkpa.
Tsúfɛ́ ɔbɩsasʋ anɩ Wíe obégyi ɔyɩ́tɔ́ ahá fɛ́ɛ́ asʋ́n, búa mʋ́ wankláán.”

Tsúfɛ́ Bulu ɔnɔ́sʋ́ ɔtɔɩ́pʋ́ Yesaia légyankpá wanlɩ́n wá Bulu asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ amʋtɔ ɔbɛ́ɛ, “Nɩ́ mɩ́ Wíe Bulu, túmi fɛ́ɛ́ Owíe mési anɩ abí-aná akʋ yáɩ́ á, tɛkɩ anɩ fɛ́ɛ́ abɛ́hɩ fɛ́ Sodom mʋ́a Gomorafɔ.”
Israelfɔ Bulu Máhogyi
Nkálɩ anɩdɛ́blɩ́ ngya? Anɩdɛ́blɩ́ anɩaa, ahá ámʋ́ʋ́ bʋmegyí Yudafɔ ámʋ bʋmɔbɔ mbɔ́dɩ́ kʋkʋ, asa Bulu lɛ́ha amʋ́ asʋ! Hógyi sʋ́ benya mʋ́.
Támɛ Israelfɔ ámʋ́ʋ́ amʋ́ ansɩ́ lɛpɛ, bʋdɛ mbla ámʋsʋ gyí, Bulu ɔha amʋ́ asʋ ámʋ bʋmɛtalɩ́.
Ntogyi sʋ? Tsúfɛ́ bʋmɛpɛ ansɩ́ pʋ́ hógyi dúnká mʋ́. Ɩlɔbwɛ amʋ́ fɛ́ mbla ámʋsʋ gyísʋ Bulu ɔbɔ́tsʋn ha amʋ́ asʋ. Ɩ́nɩ sʋ bosutíin “Ibwi ámʋ́ʋ́ ɩtɛlɛ́ ahá dá” ámʋsʋ dɩda kpla.
Ibwi ánfɩ ɩwɩ asʋ́n bɔwanlɩ́n wá Bulu asʋn wanlɩ́nhɛ́ amʋtɔ bɛɛ,

content.text: Pɛ́lɩ mɛ́ɛkɩtá ɔhagyíɔha ánɩ́ ɔlɔhɔ mʋ gyi.’ ”
